integrity: A self-contained analytic derivation, with an ordinary reproducible exact-arithmetic and simulation checker, has received same-model mathematical review; there has been no independent audit, external certification, or research claim beyond the stated scope.
scientific_limitations: The joint normality and covariance asymptotics are for fixed spacing orders, followed by a distinct sequential order-ratio limit; no simultaneous growing-window central limit theorem, fitted-parameter null, or optimal combined-test critical values are claimed. Priority against every possible general Dirichlet quadratic-form treatment is not independently established.
title: Exact cross-order null covariance and a universal correlation kernel for overlapping squared-Gini spacings
